claims.claim: RuntimeLab builds from the minimal map skeleton with current Vibe Kernel and CMLib sources, without a CMRE map, mission, or commander dependency.

The generated map entry uses TriggerLibs/natives, matching the known-working minimal CMLib test maps; the rebuilt packed map SHA-256 is 752a64905a3b3aaaa50c3336cc88900f7e0f71d59cee7efb82362e1090de871f.
The generated map has a map-local dispatch fixture, a P1/P2 GalaxyVibe BankList, and a deterministic Marine-versus-Zergling tactical fixture.

A prior BankList-enabled load reached API ping, CreateGame, JoinGame, and kernel_initialized, but no current-package VM, CMLib, or tactical-arena pass is claimed because entrypoint RPC did not complete.

The final runtime gates require an exclusive SC2 API and GalaxyVibe Bank lease. A concurrent SC2 instance is loading a different map without an API listener and all 17 GalaxyVibe Bank candidates contain shared task state, so corrected-map probe results are not attributable to RuntimeLab.
